observations: Headless p2 boot exposes DRM and audio devices, with no failed systemd unit
GPU initialization and DRM resource enumeration work while GPU runtime PM is forbidden
First atomic modeset resets even while GPU remains powered; GPU suspend is not required for the fault
Read-only helper confirms RPMh raw value 1900 mV but driver cache 1904000 uV
Applying a temporary regulator consumer constraint of 1896000 uV succeeds
Same atomic modeset then completes panel preparation and activates 3392x2400 at 120 Hz
Live trace confirms voltage vote 1896 to 0x40a00, then enable vote 1 to 0x40a04
User confirms visible color test pattern
Restoring GPU auto suspend with original 66 ms delay reaches suspended while display remains active
Exiting the pattern cleanly disables the panel and retains SSH
scope: Controlled p2 diagnostic with single CPU, cpuidle disabled, temporary external helper module. Establishes the VDDIO constraint fix; does not accept the p3 normal system. Touch firmware loads, but touch events, rendering, sound and full power-management acceptance remain untested.
formal_remaining: strict replay and complete p3 build
diagnostic_limitations: Both headless p2 boots also time out at the Brahma peripheral UART version query (one byte sent, no receive data). A transport rebind did not recover it. Bluetooth must be checked under normal p3 parameters; the initial zero-failed-unit observation was before the 90-second address-service timeout.

interpretation_scope.original_source_of_1896000: existing mainline Erhai DTS lower bound and the nldo515 8 mV selector model; not an exact Android factory setting
interpretation_scope.android_reference_collected_after_migrat: 2026-11-14: factory consumer request/init/driver report all 1900000 uV
interpretation_scope.causal_limit: Successful modeset at 1896000 uV proves this port setting works; the experiment alone does not isolate physical voltage from initialization/readback/voltage-vote effects.
